# Copilot Instructions for Creador-de-Contenido

## Project Context
This is a Spanish-language content creation project ("Creador-de-Contenido" = Content Creator). The repository is designed to help with content creation workflows and tools.

## Language and Localization
- **Primary Language**: Spanish (es)
- Use Spanish for code comments, documentation, and user-facing text
- Variable names and function names should be descriptive in Spanish when appropriate
- Error messages and user interfaces should be in Spanish
- Consider Latin American Spanish conventions

## Code Style and Standards
- Follow clean, readable code practices
- Use meaningful variable and function names in Spanish when it improves clarity
- Include comprehensive comments in Spanish for complex logic
- Prioritize code maintainability and readability

## Content Creation Focus
- When suggesting features or improvements, consider content creation workflows
- Think about tools that help with:
  - Text generation and editing
  - Media processing and management
  - Social media content planning
  - Content analytics and optimization
  - Multi-platform publishing

## Documentation Guidelines
- All README files and documentation should be in Spanish
- Include clear installation and usage instructions
- Provide examples relevant to content creators
- Document any third-party integrations or APIs used

## Development Practices
- Keep dependencies minimal and well-justified
- Consider cross-platform compatibility
- Prioritize user experience for content creators
- Include error handling with user-friendly Spanish messages

## Contribution Guidelines
- Welcome contributions from Spanish-speaking developers
- Encourage community feedback from content creators
- Maintain consistent code quality and documentation standards
